For a U.S. first-time adult passport book, the Department of State application fee is $130 and the acceptance fee paid to the acceptance facility is $35, for a combined minimum cost of $165 [d1,d8]. If you also want a passport card, the Department of State fee is $30 and the acceptance fee remains $35, totaling $65 for the card [d1,d8]. Some local acceptance facilities list bundled totals that include optional services or shipping, which can raise the total beyond these minimums [d6,d9,d10].
